# SecondTrip

SecondTrip is callback and rework analytics software for service businesses. It supplements an
existing CRM or field-service management system: teams import CSV job history, review possible
repeat visits surfaced by deterministic rules, inspect matching and non-matching evidence, and
record a human classification. SecondTrip makes no AI-based product claims.

Key pages:
- / — product introduction and FAQ
- /features — implemented workflow and product fit
- /pricing — free private-beta offer and current limits
- /contact — support, privacy, DPA, and private-beta enquiries
